title: Barbara Ann
creator: CrossFit
description: Five rounds, each for time, of 20 handstand push-ups, 30 deadlifts at 135/95 lb, 40 sit-ups and 50 double-unders, with exactly three minutes of rest between rounds. One of the seven new Girls added in January 2021; Barbara's interval format with a barbell and a rope. Score is the total of the five work rounds.
